title: 🏚️ LET THE FAKE WALLS FALL.
paragraphs: Truth shakes the foundations you thought were unbreakable. 🏗️💥
We often build our lives on comfortable lies—approval from others, temporary success, or our own ego. We think these foundations are solid until God brings the Truth like a wrecking ball.
It feels like a disaster, but it is actually a rescue mission.

When God shakes your life, He isn't trying to destroy you. He is destroying the false security you were standing on so you are forced to move your feet to the Solid Rock. If it can be shaken, it wasn't built by God.
Don't fear the earthquake. Let the lies crumble so the Truth can stand. 🧱🏔️
"Is not my word like fire," declares the LORD, "and like a hammer that breaks a rock in pieces?" — Jeremiah 23:29 (NIV)
Your Move: Type "SOLID ROCK" if you are rebuilding on the only foundation that lasts! 👇🧱
